propositions: A write-op that adds or modifies a parameter, guard, or required field on one adapter (CLI, lib, MCP) without mirroring the change to its sibling adapters creates drift and escapes detection at review time

The surface-parity overlay is a glob-triggered advisory Pass-1 code-review finder that flags divergences in write-op parameter surfaces across the three adapters (lib _lib_writes.py, CLI _commands/, MCP _mcp_writes.py) and coaches authors toward lockstep updates before landing

Deliberate surface divergences (adapter-bound params like _creation_channel/source/repo_root, internal-only refactors, justified policy omissions) must not trigger false-positive findings; the reviewer prompt carries guards to distinguish intentional from accidental drift

The overlay is advisory (blocking_enabled=false, block_threshold=0.95) and is wired into the four-pass gate's round_a and round_b batches via glob routing on the three write-surface files, enabling actual dispatch of the surface-parity finder

The overlay requires no change to reviewers/index.json because overlay prompts (category code-review-pass) are excluded from the selection catalog by design; prompt regen is a no-op and the drift gate stays green
